g.title: MOD_S
g.text: Stock module. Only the M3 header is fitted of the four pads.

g.title: S_IN
g.text: MRider's half, towards the module. Carries 87a.

g.title: W_S_IN
g.text: Brown is M3-, blue is M3+. 20 AWG because the 43030 barrel is 20-24.

g.title: MUX
g.text: Coil OFF puts 30 on 87a - the vehicle is then factory stock.

g.title: S_OUT
g.text: MRider's half, receives the vehicle's plug. Carries 30.

g.title: VEH_S
g.text: Vehicle's own, on to the steering gearmotor. NO KEY SEEN - mark polarity.

g.title: MOD_D
g.text: Stock module. Two tabs, FOUR wires - two crimped on each.

g.title: D_IN
g.text: MRider's half, towards the module. Carries 87a.

g.title: W_D_IN
g.text: Two NETS, not four wires - the stock plug does the paralleling.

g.title: D_OUT
g.text: MRider's half, receives the vehicle's plug. Carries 30.

g.title: VEH_D
g.text: Vehicle's own. The paralleling of the two rear motors is INSIDE this plug.
